title: Graduate Engineer - Graduate Program (Civil)
location: Central Victoria / Brisbane / Gold Coast / Sunshine Coast / Northern NSW
content_text: Westera Partners 4-year Graduate Engineering Program. Mentoring by Senior Engineers, professional accreditation support, variety of civil structural and environmental projects. Apply for graduate position or undergraduate work experience by emailing resume, academic transcript and application letter (preferred office and discipline) to HR@westerapartners.com.au. Offices in Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Northern NSW and Central Victoria. Core values: Client Focus, Achieve Together, Embrace Progress, Act with Integrity, Pursue Excellence.
apply_instructions: Email resume, academic transcript and application letter stating preferred office and discipline to HR@westerapartners.com.au
